subject: [PATCH 3/4] mm/madvise: skip zone device folios in cold/pageout PMD range

reviews.author: David Hildenbrand (Arm)
reviews.summary: Raised a question about whether a Fixes tag is needed for this patch, but did not express any strong opinion or technical concern.

reviews.author: Lorenzo Stoakes (ARM)
reviews.summary: Expressed approval for the patch, stating that it looks good to them and provided a Reviewed-by tag.

2026-07-28.patch_summary: This patch series addresses issues in the madvise_cold_or_pageout_pte_range function, which resolves folio backing a PMD and ages or reclaims it without checking for zone device memory. The current implementation does not cover all cases of zone device memory, leading to potential double-put bugs. This patch specifically skips ZONE_DEVICE folios during MADV_COLD/PAGEOUT operations.
